doc.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: New York 1948: Tristano and the Miles nonet
title: Two weeks at the Royal Roost
summary: Konitz recalls one week with the nonet and one with a quintet, and the Boris Rose air checks.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: Miles got two weeks for the band at the Royal Roost?

This has never been clear to me. We did one of the weeks with the band. The second week was with a quintet with me, Miles, John Lewis, Al McKibbon, and Max. That’s the history of the band working to my memory, but my memory has some stops and goes in it.

I’m going to [unintelligible] your memory in a minute but I don’t want to get ahead of us, I want to talk a little bit more about that. Do you remember much about playing at the Royal Roost? They’ve released the Boris Rose air checks.
Schwerin, yeah. Do you remember much about that gig, playing opposite Basie?
Yeah, I remember. Wow, that reminds me . . .
